body.statement: Let \(R\) be a real closed field.  There is an effective quantifier-elimination procedure for first-order formulas in the language of ordered rings with rational coefficients.  In particular, the truth of every closed formula obtained from finitely many rational polynomial equalities and strict or weak inequalities is decidable, and the procedure terminates after finitely many exact algebraic operations.

source.locator: Section 2, Decision method for elementary algebra, pages 15--42

attestation.note: The displayed effective quantifier-elimination consequence is the exact decision fact used; the stable publisher page is supplied.
